title: UNSW HDR Scholarships: UNSW 2027 March Release (Term 2, 2027 start)
field: All research disciplines (Higher Degree by Research)
about: UNSW Sydney's 2027 March Release is the Higher Degree Research scholarship round for candidates starting in Term 2, 2027. Applications close on 15 January 2027 at midnight Australian time, with offers expected from 25 March 2027.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "All research disciplines (Higher Degree by Research)" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Prospective HDR (PhD/research master's) candidates" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
